```yaml
name: Token Usage Dashboard

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Eval"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  artifacts: read

concurrency:
  group: token-usage
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  collect-token-usage:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' && github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' && github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download eval artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: eval-artifacts
          path: artifacts

      - name: Set up PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v2

      - name: Aggregate token usage data
        run: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File generate-token-data.ps1
        env:
          ARTIFACTS_PATH: artifacts

      - name: Upload token usage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage
          path: data/token-usage.json
```
